Synopsis:
Reuters FX wrap covering four Sub-Saharan African currencies. The Ugandan shilling and Ghanaian cedi are expected to weaken further, driven respectively by energy import hard-currency demand and corporate/portfolio FX flows. The Kenyan shilling is forecast to remain stable. The Zambian kwacha is holding in a consolidative range, supported by elevated copper prices and reduced speculative pressure, despite minor depreciation. Zambia's political backdrop (Hichilema re-elected amid controversy) is noted but not seen as a near-term FX destabiliser.
